content.short: Kintsu is a liquid staking protocol operating on Monad and Hyperliquid.
content.description: Kintsu issues liquid staking tokens so stakers keep an asset they can use in DeFi while their stake continues earning, and operates across Monad and Hyperliquid. Running the same design on several chains gives a liquid staking provider an advantage in integrations, since protocols that already support one deployment find the next one easy to add.
